Launcher guides

Check your PS5 playtime and see it on your PC

On your PS5, open your profile and select Games: each game shows the hours you played, PS4 games included. To bring those hours into PlayCounter, open My Games, choose PlayStation and select Import from PlayStation.

By the PlayCounter project · Updated 24 September 2026 · 3 steps

  1. Find hours on the PS5
  2. Import into PlayCounter
  3. See PS5 sessions live
On this page
  • Find hours played on the PS5
  • Import your PS5 and PS4 hours into PlayCounter
  • See PS5 sessions live on your PC
  • How PS5 hours add up

Find hours played on the PS5

  1. On the home screen, select your profile picture in the top-right corner, then Profile.
  2. Open Games.
  3. Each game shows its hours played and when you last played it.

The PS5 shows whole hours. Games you played on a PS4 with the same account are listed too.

Import your PS5 and PS4 hours into PlayCounter

Worth doing once: signing in brings in the playtime Sony recorded for every PS5 and PS4 game you played, and PlayCounter keeps it up to date by itself.

  1. Open PlayStation in My Games

    In the sidebar under My Games, select PlayStation, then Import from PlayStation. After your first import, the button says Import more from PlayStation.

  2. Sign in

    Select Sign in and find games and sign in with Sony in the window that opens. If Sony’s page does not work there, select Sign in with a code on the Launcher accounts page: sign in at playstation.com in your browser, open Sony’s sign-in code page and paste what it shows.

  3. Review and import

    Recognized games wait in Ready to import. Games under Needs you ask you to pick the right game first. Then select Import.

You sign in directly with Sony; PlayCounter does not see your password. The app keeps the sign-in on your PC, encrypted for your Windows account; Sign out on the Launcher accounts page deletes it. Sony asks for a new sign-in about every two months. Only your game list, Sony’s playtime, the game running on the console and your online ID reach the app, and the PlayCounter API only receives PlayStation Store concept IDs, plus the titles of games it does not recognize, to look them up. Import privacy details.

See PS5 sessions live on your PC

  1. Leave PlayCounter running on your PC.
  2. Start a game on your PS5 or PS4.
  3. Within about a minute it shows in Now Playing, marked with the console.
  4. Quit the game: the session ends and appears in My History.

This needs Live from PlayStation on the PlayStation card under Launcher accounts, which is on by default. PlayCounter asks Sony about once a minute. Play while your PC is off still arrives with Sony’s next total.

How PS5 hours add up

Sony’s total is console play, so it never overlaps the sessions PlayCounter records on your PC: it is added to your PC time instead of compared with it. 10 hours on PS5 and 2 hours PlayCounter tracked on your PC show 12 hours. PlayCounter reads Sony’s list again by itself at start, every hour and a few minutes after a console session, and new games you play on PlayStation show up in My Games on their own. How launcher totals combine.
